{{Quote|Listen, Duchess. Do you hear the people? They cry out for change. Your weak-minded rule of Mandalore is at an end. The resurrection of our warrior past is about to begin!|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] to [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]|<ref name="SoR" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] allied with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], launching a coup against the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|government]] in an attempted '''takeover of Mandalore'''. Together, the [[Death/Legends|Death]] Watch and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] assembled an [[Army/Legends|army]] of criminals, from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] to the [[Limb/Legends|foot]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]], all coming together as a coalition known as the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]. In order to undermine the rule of the New Mandalorian leadership, the Collective's criminal element was ordered to attack New Mandalorian territory across [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]—including the New Mandalorians' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]—in order to sow panic and chaos, only for the Death Watch to arrive as rescuers, saving the people from the offworld attackers.

The Shadow Collective's plans succeeded, and Pre Vizsla was able to dethrone the New Mandalorian leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], and replace her as [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] and self-titled [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]. However, Vizsla's ambitions led him to betray his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies and have them [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]]. While in prison, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul came across the former Prime [[Minister]] of the New Mandalorian people, [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], and elected to use the disgraced leader to replace Vizsla. Breaking free of his incarceration, Maul stormed the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] with his apprentice and Almec in tow, challenging Vizsla to a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] for leadership. Honorbound, Vizsla accepted, and the two combatants [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fought]] ferociously through the throne room, but ultimately it was Maul who proved victorious, [[Sai cha/Legends|slaying]] Vizsla and taking his place as leader of Death Watch. Installing Almec as the new Prime Minister, Maul secured a puppet ruler to lead the New Mandalorians while keeping his presence in the background a secret to the populace at large.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Our combined strength ''will'' be rewarded, Mandalore will be yours—and Kenobi, this Sith pretender Dooku, and ''all'' our enemies will fall.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to Pre Vizsla|<ref name="Eminence" />}}
While traveling through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], members of the radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter-faction known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] came across a derelict [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] drifting above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Upon [[Docking tube/Legends|boarding]] the craft, Death Watch discovered the unconscious bodies of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]; at the word of the group's leader, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the two [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]] were brought aboard one of Death Watch's [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighters]]—Vizsla's personal [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the [[Gauntlet (Pre Vizsla)/Legends|''Gauntlet'']]—and taken back to the Death Watch's [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|encampment]]<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-covered [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]].<ref name="Zanbar">{{SWE|locations|zanbar|Zanbar}}</ref> There, Death Watch attended to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] injuries before Vizsla invited Darth Maul to talk, during which the two found they had a mutual enemy in the form of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] equally despised by both [[Gender/Legends|men]]. Upon that shared animosity, Maul and Vizsla founded an alliance in pursuit of mutual benefit: the Sith would aid Death Watch in deposing [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], while Death Watch would assist the Sith in their plans to punish Kenobi for his [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|actions]] against Maul a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

Together, Death Watch and the Sith set out to assemble an [[Army/Legends|army]] of followers, beginning their search at a [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|fortress]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] belonging to the leaders of a branch of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Negotiations with the syndicate branch's [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] leaders were quick to sour, leading Savage Opress to [[Sai cha/Legends|kill]] them while Maul recruited the organization's [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]], [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], who authorized an alliance in the fallen leaders' stead. Back on Zanbar, with freshly gained supplies and a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] in tow, Pre Vizsla and Maul were approached by [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], leader of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-dealing [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Having caught word of Maul's intentions to raise a force of criminals, the [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]] moved to willingly join the growing assembly, and were readily welcomed by Death Watch and the Sith. With their newest allies, Death Watch [[Mission to Nal Hutta/Legends|set out]] for [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where Maul spoke before an assembly of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]].<ref name="Eminence" /> The five assembled leaders of the Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] responded hostilely to Darth Maul's demands and his refusal to offer any [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' services, ordering a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]—[[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], and [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]]—and a cadre of Hutt servant [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to kill the offending visitors.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> The Sith and Death Watch forces overwhelmed the Hutts' minions and hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], however, [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] the Hutt and [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|pursuing]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where Jabba and [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] agreed to join forces with Maul's criminal assembly at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]].<ref name="Eminence" /> The Hutt families contributed [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] enforcers to the enterprise, and the Collective traveled back to [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] to make final preparations for the coup.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

[[File:ShadowCollectivePlotting.png|thumb|left|300px|The [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] plans the assault on [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]]]
Though Death Watch and the Sith now had an army with which to act, known in total as the "[[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]," tensions between Maul and Pre Vizsla began to emerge as the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] revealed his plans to use the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] as a power base from which he could conduct an underworld empire of his own.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Vizsla's own ambitions extended no further than Mandalore and the downfall of the pacifist New Mandalorian regime,<ref name="SoR" /> and so he began making preparations to betray Maul and his brother, Opress, once his goals were met.<ref name="Eminence" /> Likewise, Maul suspected Vizsla's inclinations toward treachery and began planning for the time when he would turn on the Mandalorian in kind. Despite their mutual misgivings, Maul and Vizsla assembled the leaders<ref name="SoR" /> of the Shadow Collective on Zanbar, where they made plans to attack the New Mandalorians' [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] with the Collective's criminal element, terrorizing the populace at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of Black Sun and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], before sending in the Death Watch to act as saviors against the invading gangsters. With their plans made and their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] mobilized, the Shadow Collective set out for Mandalore.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

==The takeover==
===Peace under siege===
{{Quote|I will use my army of crime lords to attack different targets across Sundari, and sow chaos to undermine the Duchess's rule. Our gangsters will make her look too weak to maintain control. Then you and your Death Watch will capture and arrest us, bringing order where Satine's weak government cannot.|Darth Maul to Pre Vizsla|<ref name="SoR" />}}
[[File:SundariDocksAssault-SOR.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Shadow Collective's attack begins]]
Landing on Mandalore at the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|shipping docks]] of Sundari, under the guise of [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] vessels [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] shipments of spice, Pyke Syndicate thugs and Black Sun foot soldiers ambushed members of the New [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] force from shipping containers believed to be carrying the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] goods. The criminal contingent overpowered the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] and [[New Mandalorian customs department/Legends|customs]] officials, violently subduing and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoning]] the New Mandalorians and their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in shipping containers, securing control of the docks.<ref name="SoR" /> In [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park]], in the shadow of the destroyed [[Memorial Shrine/Legends|Memorial Shrine]], Black Sun soldiers and Pyke gunmen under Ziton Moj opened [[Lightfight|fire]] on the crowd, killing police and civilians alike in an indiscriminatory manner aimed at causing panic.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> And at the [[Mandalore Banking Center/Legends|Mandalore Banking Center]],<ref name="SoRGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep515|text="Shades of Reason" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Lom Pyke led a team to attack and rob the facility,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> using the combat prowess and [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] of Savage Opress to carve through the police defenders and enter the [[Bank/Legends|bank]].<ref name="SoR" />

Within short order, the Shadow Collective's operatives had overwhelmed Sundari's defenders<ref name="SoR" /> and overran Duchess Satine Kryze's forces throughout New Mandalorian territory across the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] regions of Mandalore in which the New Mandalorian people made their [[Bio-cube/Legends|home]]. The concerned New Mandalorian citizenry gathered in [[Sundari Royal Palace plaza/Legends|the plaza]] outside of the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] demanding action, prompting Duchess Kryze to issue a statement to her people asking for calm in the face of the criminal attacks, and urging them to resist the temptation of violence.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Amidst Kryze's entreaties to the public, the Death Watch appeared over the square, lead by Pre Vizsla. Though Kryze was quick to blame Death Watch for the attacks, Vizsla denied any wrongdoing and pledged his support to the people, decrying Kryze and her [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|administration]] for its inability to protect the New Mandalorians. Winning favor with the angry crowd with his words, Vizsla and his cadre of Death Watch soldiers departed the palace to enact the second phase of the Shadow Collective's plan.<ref name="SoR" />

[[File:DeathWatchAndSatine-SoR.png|thumb|left|300px|Death Watch arrives in Sundari promising to protect the people from the Shadow Collective]]
A detachment of Death Watch soldiers struck at the Black Sun and Pyke gangsters holding the docks of Sundari, securing the area after arriving in force. The rogue Mandalorians freed the grateful hostages from their confines in the docks' shipping containers and apprehended the offworld criminals. Deeper into the city,<ref name="SoR" /> Pre Vizsla's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and the Death Watch's [[Sergeant-at-Arms/Legends|Sergeant at Arms]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]],<ref name="Bo-Katan">{{SWE|characters|bokatan|Bo-Katan}}</ref> engaged the foot soldiers of the Shadow Collective alongside her personal [[Squad/Legends|unit]], the [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]]. Capturing the criminals with [[Fibercord whip/Legends|fibercord whips]], the Nite Owls led the subdued horde of thugs away at blasterpoint while Bo-Katan assured the frightened citizens nearby that they would be safe now, assurances that were met with thanks and approval.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Outside the Mandalore Banking Center,<ref name="SoRGuide" /> as Savage Opress and the Pykes fled the pillaged facility, Pre Vizsla confronted the Sith apprentice in a staged [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] as his troops secured the other thieves. Overcoming Opress before the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the police, Vizsla disarmed his opponent and turned him over to the officers' custody.<ref name="SoR" />

For their actions against the Shadow Collective, the people of Sundari were vocal in their praise of Death Watch, and with the popular support of the New Mandalorians, Pre Vizsla marched into the Royal Palace to confront Duchess Kryze. Refusing to allow her [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] to engage the Death Watch intruders due to her strong pacifistic beliefs, Kryze peacefully submitted to Vizsla, conceding to the apparent will of her people. The deposed duchess was [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]] along with her supporters in the New Mandalorian government, including [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Armatan/Legends|Armatan]], while Vizsla flaunted the captured leaders of the crime syndicates before Sundari's citizens as his prisoners and a symbol of his own worthiness to rule. Vizsla installed himself as the new Prime Minister,<ref name="SoR" /> and took up the title<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> of [[Anti-Mandalore|''Mand'alor'']] of the New Mandalorian people.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

===The Sith betrayal===
{{Quote|The transition of power will be seamless. We now have the support of the people, and Satine to bait Kenobi. With his demise, our deal will be complete.''"<br />"''Your oversight requires correction. We now have a base, an army, and the means to expand to other neutral systems.''"<br />"''It wasn't an oversight. It was ''intentional''. I don't have an interest in the other systems. Your vision no longer matters.|Pre Vizsla and Darth Maul|<ref name="SoR" />}}
Shortly after Pre Vizsla's rise to power, Darth Maul traveled to the Sundari Royal Palace to meet with the new ''Mand'alor'' and discuss the Shadow Collective's future. However, with his own goals already met, Vizsla turned on Maul and refused to aid the Sith Lord in moving against the other [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|neutral systems]] over whom the New Mandalorian state held sway. Maul was captured, and shown off to the people of Sundari as the last of the criminal element that had attacked the New Mandalorian capital during a speech in which Vizsla revealed his intentions to remilitarize the New Mandalorian populace. Maul was then taken to prison, and jailed alongside his apprentice.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

[[File:Pre_vs_Maul-SOR.png|thumb|right|300px|Pre Vizsla and Darth Maul fight for leadership]]
Maul had expected Vizsla's eventual betrayal, and the Zabrak Sith had already planned to have Vizsla replaced by a more malleable servant.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Freeing themselves from their cell, Maul and Savage Opress walked the prison complex until coming upon the [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|incarcerated]] former Prime Minister of the New Mandalorian people, [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]. Deciding Almec would play favorably into his plans, Maul freed the disgraced [[Politics/Legends|politician]], and departed the prison for the Royal Palace. Storming the throne room with Opress and Almec at his back, Maul issued a challenge to Vizsla of single combat, with the winner assuming the right to lead.<ref name="SoR" /> Honorbound by the ancient [[Canons of Honor|warrior codes]] he sought to revive, Vizsla could not refuse the challenge and, drawing his heirloom [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]], engaged Maul in a duel. The two combatants [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fought]] fiercely,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> with Vizsla employing every tool and weapon with which his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] was equipped—from [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], to blasters and a [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] launcher—but ultimately it was Maul who emerged victorious. Defeated, Vizsla was [[Sai cha/Legends|slain]] by Maul, who claimed the fallen warrior's Darksaber and his leadership over Death Watch. Yet while much of the radical Mandalorian faction knelt before their new leader, Bo-Katan and a number of other soldiers refused to serve a non-Mandalorian leader, fleeing the palace under heavy fire from those who were loyal to Maul. With Vizsla gone, Darth Maul reinstated Almec as Prime Minister, a puppet ruler who served Maul in secret while providing the people with a public face of leadership.<ref name="SoR" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Hear me now! Duchess Satine, the so-called pacifist who could not protect you when your lives were at stake, has ''murdered'' Pre Vizsla, the true ''hero'' of Mandalore. Satine is now under arrest, and it was Pre Vizsla's last command that ''I'' be reinstated as Prime Minister. I know my past is checkered, but I promise you I take full responsibility for my people, and my heart now ''bleeds'' for your pain. However, from this point on, Mandalore ''will'' be strong, and we ''will'' be known as the warriors we were always meant to be!|Prime Minister [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] addressing the New Mandalorian people|<ref name="SoR" />|audio = AlmecSpeech-SOR.flac}}
[[File:AlmecDeathWatch-ShadesOfReason.png|thumb|left|300px|Prime Minister Almec addresses the people of Sundari, flanked by Death Watch soldiers]]
Upon his return to office, Prime Minister Almec addressed the people of Sundari, informing the citizens that Pre Vizsla was dead as he blamed Duchess Kryze for his murder. Almec also stated that it had been Vizsla's last wish that Almec succeed the Death Watch leader as Prime Minister, and decreed that the New Mandalorians would indeed re-embrace the Mandalorian warrior traditions. On the order of Darth Maul, Almec set out to assemble a new hand-picked administration,<ref name="SoR" /> and maintained Mandalore's neutrality in the Clone Wars.<ref name="Lawless" />

The deposed former duchess, Satine Kryze, was able to briefly escape jail with the aid of her estranged sister Bo-Katan, and nephew [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]], managing to send a message to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with word of the Shadow Collective's takeover before being recaptured. At the news, Kryze's former lover Obi-Wan Kenobi traveled to Mandalore in an attempt to free Kryze—unknowingly doing as Maul had planned—only for his efforts to fail. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master was captured and taken before Maul, where Kryze was [[Shiak|stabbed]] and killed in front of Kenobi in revenge for Kenobi [[Sai tok/Legends|cutting]] the Sith Lord in half and leaving him for dead ten years prior. Though Maul intended to have Kenobi imprisoned so that he would be forced to live hopelessly with his grief, the Jedi Master was rescued by Bo-Katan and escorted out of Sundari amid a [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|violent struggle]] between the [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]] loyal to Maul and Bo-Katan's forces.<ref name="Lawless" /> Kenobi was rushed offworld aboard a ''Kom'rk'' fighter,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> while the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] arrived in Sundari to engage his former apprentice, Darth Maul. Maul and his own apprentice, Savage Opress, faced off against his former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], but Opress was eventually slain and Maul subdued by Sidious' powerful [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], though Maul was spared in order to serve the Dark Lord's own future purposes.<ref name="Lawless" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow Collective's takeover of Mandalore first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'', a young-reader novel published by [[Scholastic]] on [[January 1]], [[2013]]. The novel adapts the events of four episodes from the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', including "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]," "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]," "[[Shades of Reason]]," and "[[The Lawless]]." The later three episodes of this four-part story arc depict the planning and execution of the takeover. The [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 34|thirty-fourth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine, published by [[De Agostini]] in [[2014]], officially identified the conflict as the "Takeover of Mandalore," though other sources illustrate that the Death Watch's coup only secured the sect localized control.
